text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Get this, familiar! I found a new friend<n>for you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I've found myself in front<n>of the station
with Sweep Tosho on<n>my day off. About an hour
ago...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, I've been looking all over for<n>you! C'mon,
it's time to go shopping!
choice_data_list: When did I agree to that?!
When did I agree to that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I just found this today. "Introducing<n>the Magical
Doggy, a plushie that<n>soothes your soul with its
adorable<n>eyes—available now!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a magical doggy! I'm so getting<n>my hands on
one, so hurry it up, will<n>you?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thus, we arrive at the nearest toy<n>shop in search of
this magical<n>plushie...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What do you mean it's sold<n>out?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, this is no time to be standing<n>around!
Familiar, to the next shop we<n>go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're sold out too?! How come?!<n>You better not
be hiding one in the<n>back!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
None here, either! Urgh, then the<n>search continues,
familiar! We're<n>going until we find one!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, no matter which toy<n>shop we go to,
the "Magical Doggy"<n>plush is sold out.
choice_data_list: If we haven't found one by now, then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What're you down in the<n>dumps for?! I
definitely want one, so<n>we're not giving up this
easily!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, this is all your fault,<n>familiar! If you kept
up with me, I<n>might've been able to buy one before
they sold out everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sooo getting my hands on one.<n>Familiar,
where's the next store?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sweep being stubborn is nothing new,<n>but I'm a
little curious as to why<n>she's so adamant on
getting this<n>particular toy.
choice_data_list: How come you want this plushie so badly?
How come you want this plushie so badly?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I know I want it, and that's that! Ineed my own Magical Doggy!
choice_data_list: So the Magical Doggy is special to you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right! 'Cause Grandma had<n>one just like it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma's Dog
text_block_list.text: Bark, bark!

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text: Sob... Hic. Just go away...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in saying things you<n>don't mean. I
placed a spell on<n>her—she can read the minds of
others.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
...What's that? Deep down, Sweepy<n>wants to
apologize to her papa?

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not what I was thinking at<n>all! I mean,
there's no way I'd say<n>sorry to Papa...

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
There's no way... But wow, your<n>magic is so cool
Grandma.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just like Grandma, I want a doggy<n>that can read
minds! But I can't keep<n>pets at the dorm, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want a Magical Doggy.<n>I'll cast a
spell on it...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And make it into a mind-reading<n>plushie. Then I'll
be one step closer<n>to becoming a great witch like
Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho wants the plushie<n>because it makes
her feel closer to<n>her grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But it's gotten dark out already.<n>Sweep might be
tired from running<n>around all day.
choice_data_list: It's getting late, so let's call it here for today.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I just say no to that! Why<n>don't you get it?
If you wanna go<n>home that much, just go by
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next morning, I spot Sweep as I<n>wait by the
academy gate and call out<n>to her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What, you feel like apologizing now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I bet you looked for only a<n>little bit. You
probably couldn't find it!
choice_data_list:
Then here's a question for you. What could this
be?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What? What do you m—huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hand over the promised present to a<n>speechless
Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A Magical Doggy! You really found<n>one?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But, it was sold out everywhere! I<n>totally thought it
was a lost cause...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Magical Doggy plushie is really<n>popular, so I
had to call a toy store in<n>the neighboring prefecture
to snag<n>one.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You mean you really kept looking<n>after you sent me
home?!
choice_data_list: You need it to become a great witch, don't you?
You need it to become a great witch, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: For me... to become a witch...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Saying it would help her become a<n>witch was a bit
of a stretch, but I also<n>believed it would give her the
push<n>she needed to keep chasing her<n>dreams.
choice_data_list: Take good care of me! Ruff!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-what am I gonna do with you?<n>Fine then, I'll
be your new master!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well... Y'know? It's only natural for a<n>familiar to
work for their master,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even if my familiar didn't find it, I<n>probably
would've found it myself,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer helped you, right? Make<n>sure to say
thank you later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I don't care! It's not like I<n>asked for help.
My familiar did it all on<n>their own!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I really found myself a weird familiar...<n>Doggy, you
think so too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What's that face for?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're wrong! I'm not grateful tothem at all, and you're so off themark!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's enough—you gotta learn how<n>to read minds
better, you hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her grumbling, Sweep Tosho<n>hugs her
Magical Doggy tightly and<n>crawls under the covers.
